Conditional Servo ON: SmoothieBox DRVX/DRVZ .5/.6 drive TI ULN2003AN inputs1/2 and logic return pin8 through proposed 10 kΩ idle-low pull-downs. Outputs16/15 sink separate 390 Ω current-limited AQY212GS LEDs pins1/2; each isolated NO contact pins3/4 switches fitted JASD CN1.9 DI1− to its separate 24 V return, with CN1.11 COM+ fed from external +24 V. ULN pins3–7 held low, pins9–14 NC. Every DI1 function/polarity and electrical rating requires qualification.

Conditional Lenze 8214 digital interface: native SmoothieBox SSR1.1/.2 RUN and PWM.2 TTL/PWM.3 DIRECTION feed separate ULN2003AN channels1/2. Phoenix 2966265 A1/A2 coils are host24V; isolated contact11 common/14 NO switches separate field nominal24V to Lenze28 RUN and E4 direction; field return is Lenze39 GND2. Terminal7 analog GND1 and terminal20 internal821X 15V/20mA are unused in this digital circuit; relay12 NC unused.

wire_panels.title: CONDITIONAL JASD v1.3 X/Z position command · SmoothieBox → AM26C31 → 5 V CN1 differential inputs
wire_panels.note: MANUFACTURER CONDITIONAL REFERENCE; not a verified fitted Schaublin drive, motor, cabinet or harness. Owner post #259199 says the JMC drives run in analog mode and considers temporary STEP/DIR position-mode tuning. Match both physical drive nameplates, revision and CN1 schedule to this recovered JASD v1.3 mirror before selecting this alternative. The owner-linked 1806080392.pdf is now unavailable; this mirror is not proven byte-identical. AM26C31 is a proposed four-channel 16-pin line-driver on an external adapter; its one common 0 V must be confirmed compatible with all four SmoothieBox DRVX/DRVZ GND fields. No 24 V pulse terminals, high-speed terminals or CN1 digital GND are joined to these differential pairs. Both enable pins select active outputs while 5 V is present; proposed 10 kΩ input pull-downs prevent floating CMOS inputs but do not constitute a safety stop, and rail ramp/boot/reset/disconnect pulse behavior requires bench proof with the motors inhibited. TI specifies 4.5–5.5 V supply, VIH≥2 V, VIL≤0.8 V, recommended ±20 mA output and a nearby 0.1 µF bypass. Manufacturer CN1 opto input with two 120 Ω resistors is shown in printed p.38; output current, polarity, edge timing, 500 kHz maximum, cable, EMC and receiver fit require measurement; no claim that the shown driver is automatically electrically qualified. P01-01=0, P03-00=0, P03-01=1, P03-02=0 are manufacturer position/STEP-DIR/low-speed selections, not fitted settings. DRVX/DRVZ ENABLE fields remain unconnected here; Servo ON is a distinct 24 V DI circuit. CN1 contact numbers below are manufacturer table positions only; no fabricated shell face/cavity geometry.

wire_panels.title: CONDITIONAL Lenze8214 isolated spindle speed · native PWM → low-pass → isolated0–10V
wire_panels.note: Conditional design only: identify fitted drive and isolator revisions, verify Lenze0–10V jumper, measured PWM amplitude/frequency and startup defaults, low-pass component tolerances/loading/settling, configured voltage output and full-scale calibration. Manufacturer isolation rating must suit actual common-mode/cabinet; no reference bond across barrier or to Lenze39. Qualify open/short/power-loss behavior with drive inhibited before use. Native0–5V PWM uses carrier spindle connector, not a raw3.3V pin. 10kΩ/4.7µF is a proposed first-order passive filter; actualPWM≥20kHz and input>1Mohm are conditions, not fitted measurements. Factory isolator all-off config is CURRENT output0–20mA, not voltage: explicitly select/read back0–5V input and0–10V voltageoutput. Nominal24V power3/4 remains separate from signalinput1/2 and output5/6;7/8 are internally duplicatepower, not signal returns. Lenze7 GND1 must not be merged with39 GND2. This speed circuit does not include RUN/DIR or replace machine safety. Remaining Lenze terminals belong to separate digital/power inventories. Independent static review finds nominal47ms time constant, about216ms to1percent and ideal2.66mV peak-to-peak output ripple at20kHz/half duty. Loading permits approximately9.90V full-scale before module errors, so measure and calibrate rather than promise10V. An open resistor/reference can float the filter; an open capacitor removes filtering; charged capacitor can command speed on restart. Keep drive enable independently inhibited until valid zero command and stop behavior are established. This circuit is not fail-safe.

wire_panels.title: CONDITIONAL Lenze 8214 digital RUN/DIR · SmoothieBox → ULN2003AN → two Phoenix 24 V gold-signal relays
wire_panels.note: OWNER-REPORTED DRIVE FAMILY / CONDITIONAL MANUFACTURER INTERFACE, not verified fitted nameplate or cabinet continuity. Owner post #338649 names Lenze 8214, terminal 28 enable, E4 direction, 39 digital reference and reports original Mesa connections. Manufacturer 8200 SHB 0199 indexed text (printed pp.4-38/4-40/4-41) gives terminal 28 and E4 HIGH 12–30 V, LOW 0–3 V; 39 is GND2, distinct from analog GND1 terminal 7. A separate nominal 24 V field supply (within the 12–30 V high range) feeds Phoenix PLC-RSC-24DC/21AU 2966265 intact-gold contacts 11→14; each Lenze input has a proposed 10 kΩ pull-down to digital 39 so an open NO contact has a defined LOW and a closed contact has ~2.4 mA resistor current at 24 V before input current, within the manufacturer's 1 mA minimum at 24 V / 50 mA maximum / 36 V DC maximum only if actual measured contact current and voltage meet the intact-gold ratings. The two Phoenix coils are separate host-side nominal 24 V loads at A1/A2, driven by ULN2003AN collectors 16/15; integrated freewheel/polarity diodes are source-confirmed, so observe A1-positive/A2-sink and do not add an invented external diode. Their 18.5–33.6 V 20°C coil operating range and typical 9 mA are source values, not host supply proof. Native SmoothieBox SSR1.1/.2 RUN and PWM.2 TTL/PWM.3 DIRECTION assignments are candidates: their actual output level/current, firmware mapping, polarity, turn-on/off and boot/reset/disconnect behavior must be measured before use. Two proposed 10 kΩ logic input pull-downs and ULN inputs 3–7 tied low leave unused collectors 10–14 and COM9 NC. Relay terminal 12 NC is unused. Phoenix's safe-isolation rating is a component source claim, not qualification of this fitted cabinet common-mode, installation or safety function. No host logic 0 V, coil 24 V return, field digital 39, analog 7, cabinet PE or Lenze internal terminal 20 is joined by label. E4 is factory CW LOW / CCW HIGH in the manual but programmable; verify fitted configuration and actual spindle rotation with independent safe stop. Process RUN/DIR relays do not replace hardwired E-stop, brake, contactor or protection. Manufacturer PDF bytes were not locally recovered (direct HTTP403); cited terminal claims are from indexed text, so final fitment and manual readback remain mandatory. Field 10 kΩ resistors are proposed at ≥0.25 W, with measured thermal margin; 30 V across 10 kΩ dissipates 0.09 W before tolerance. Do not change direction while RUN is asserted: command zero, verify standstill using the fitted drive procedure, inhibit RUN, set direction, and enable only after the qualified relay settling interval. Independent direction relay supply loss or disconnect may select CW while RUN remains asserted. Qualification must establish fault detection and drive inhibit before direction-control faults or changes, including relay bounce, settling and restart interlock. This proposed topology alone does not enforce that interlock. Verify coil pickup after ULN saturation and suppression transients over rated temperature/supply bounds; validate minimum contact switching load at the actual field voltage.
